title: rosa eglanteria var. cretica
intro: Rosa eglanteria var. cretica, commonly known as Rosa Cretica, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rosa genus. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa Cretica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, wounds, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Rosa Cretica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
